title: Interior Grid Formats: Case Bound and Educational Publications
slide_intent: Teach publication designers to reserve a predictable place for figures and captions so readers can stay oriented during sustained reading.
strategic_value: NASA can give educational books a quieter reading rhythm while still making room for illustrations beside the relevant passage.
demonstration: Three spread pairs place pictures within text columns, in the outer margin, or in a bleed opposite single-column text. The top notes connect these book formats to wider margins and the use of serif type.
practical_value: Decide whether an illustration needs to follow the copy inside a column, sit in a margin, or occupy a full field across from the text.

content_islands.name: Book-format guidance
content_islands.spec: Set the heading at upper left. Keep each lettered treatment with its notes about scale, captions and text setting.

content_islands.name: Three book grids
content_islands.spec: Arrange three rows of paired diagrams with the same scale and visible guides. Draw a two-column text measure with wide margins in a, a single column with marginal illustrations in b, and a top caption band with bleed photography in c.
